verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover per-key concurrency limits via CEL expressions (e.g., premium vs standard tiers), shared concurrency rules across workflows per user, configurable queue-depth strategies (CANCEL_QUEUED_EXCEPT_NEWEST/OLDEST), and a dedicated Rate Limits reference page alongside a Concurrency reference page, directly matching the per-workflow/per-key/per-tenant throttling story. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of rate-limit or per-tenant isolation behavior under real load, and no explicit doc example scoping limits strictly 'per tenant' as opposed to per-key/user.
